Book questions

What this book is for

Answered from the same facts the shelf shows, nothing more.

Who is A Modern Approach to Verbal & Non-Verbal Reasoning for?

Covers the common verbal and non-verbal question types and shows the pattern behind each one.

What does A Modern Approach to Verbal & Non-Verbal Reasoning cover?

Covers the full reasoning syllabus - series, coding-decoding, blood relations, direction sense, syllogisms and non-verbal figures - with solved examples per pattern.

Which exams is A Modern Approach to Verbal & Non-Verbal Reasoning useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Staff Selection Commission, Banking Exams, Railway Recruitment, Central Armed Police Forces, General competitive.
